Title: Maintenance Proposals Current State
Content: The /proposals workbench is the authenticated approval surface for maintenance-agent write proposals. MaintenanceProposalWorkflow persists proposal JSON through FileMaintenanceProposalStore, records open/respond/approve/reject/revision history, applies approved file changes only after current file content still matches the proposal before-text, and blocks closed proposal changes. The Proposals UI lists proposals, shows diff/evidence/comments/topic-map tabs, can run maintenance tasks, and its Request Agent Review button calls MaintenanceAgentService.ReviewProposalAsync. Review execution records agent_review_requested and agent_review_completed history/comments without changing the original proposal status; when the provider returns a valid revised proposal, SubmitAgentRevisionAsync saves the revision with metadata.supersedes and records agent_revision_proposed on the original while keeping both proposals reviewable.
